_about: Single source of truth for adapter, base-skill and device status (features/web/sensor_positioning.feature, proposed). Pages render it via {{cap:<id>.<name|stage|label|description>}} (web/scripts/wave-status.mjs); test/capabilities.test.mjs holds every page to it. Build input only: not shipped.

stages.planned: Declared; nothing is trained or built for it yet.
stages.lab: Trained or built and measured on our own benchmark; not released, and no field claim.
stages.release-candidate: Passed its own release gate; not yet installable by a customer.
stages.available: A customer can install it on their own machine, and its card is published.

capabilities.name: Fire early warning
capabilities.description: An add-on for Wave Pico, built to read smoke chemistry and heat against a baseline and raise a warning that says why and how sure it is.

capabilities.name: Telemetry drift
capabilities.description: Not an add-on: built into the base model. It is designed to flag a reading drifting out of its normal band, with how sure it is.

capabilities.name: Your own
capabilities.description: An add-on trained on your own machines and your own normal days. You will be able to build one; the tooling is not built yet.

devices.name: Laptop or desktop
devices.description: RogerAI installs on macOS, Linux and Windows. No speed is printed until one is measured on the machine.

devices.name: Industrial PC
devices.description: The fanless box already on the floor, with Linux on an Intel, AMD or ARM chip. RogerAI installs on it; its speed is not measured yet, so none is printed.

devices.name: iPad
devices.description: The RogerAI app already runs compact models on the iPad; Wave models and adapters are not built for it yet.
